title: Jack Grealish hosts secret 'Grealfields' bash to celebrate 30th birthdayShare on FacebookShare on XShare on Reddit
text:
Jack Grealish turned 30 on September 10 – and true to form, he celebrated in unforgettable style.

The on-loan Everton star threw his very own secret festival the weekend before his birthday, aptly named “Grealfields" – a playful twist on the iconic Creamfields music festival.

Photos from the event revealed a full festival-style set-up: a giant tent housing a sprawling DJ booth, stacks of speakers, flashy lighting rigs, and even a private circular bar. Guests were handed custom VIP passes stamped with “Grealfields – Jack’s 30th Birthday,” giving the party a genuine big-weekend vibe.

The guest list was just as eye-catching.

Alongside his long-time girlfriend Sasha Attwood were famous faces including Coronation Street’s Andy Whyment (better known as Kirk Sutherland) and former England striker Wayne Rooney. Grealish himself was pictured blowing out candles on a towering cake in front of friends and family.

Sharing photos on Instagram afterwards, the midfielder wrote: “30!! Jeeez this one feels old! But really am feeling the best I’ve felt in ages! Thank you everyone for the birthday wishes and a big thank you to all my incredible family & friends for making my 30th one to remember last week!”

With no England call-up during the international break and Everton not back in action for a few more days, Grealish had plenty of time to recover from Grealfields – assuming there was a hangover to recover from.
